main_topics: Consumer behavior changes in real estate

episode_summary: Vija Williams discusses the changing landscape of real estate, emphasizing the importance of reaching potential sellers before they contact agents. She highlights the role of cash offer leads and AI in adapting to new consumer behaviors. The episode provides insights on how agents can differentiate themselves by offering multiple solutions and embracing new technologies.
